title.narrative: Improving the resilience of the health system in Mali - Mali (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mali, RSSH, Ministry of Health and Social Development of the Republic of Mali (MOH Mali)This program has the following goals: SRPS : Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'état de santé et du bien-être de la population malienne / RSSH: Contribute to improving the health and well-being of the Malian population. The objectives of this program are: SRPS : Le système d’approvisionnement est régulièrement renforcé pour assurer la mise a disposition des produits de santé / RSSH: The supply system is regularly strengthened to ensure the availability of health products. SRPS : Le système d’approvisionnement est régulièrement renforcé pour la mise en place d'un réseau national de laboratoires performants / RSSH: The supply system is regularly strengthened for the implementation of a naitonal network of efficient laboratories. SRPS : Les services délivrés par le système de santé (public, privé et communautaire) sont résilients et pérennes pour améliorer la santé de la population / RSSH: the services provided by the health system (public, private and community) are resilient and sustainable to improve the health of the population

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for MLI-S-MOHP02
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
Percentage of service delivery reports from community health units integrated/interoperable with the national HMIS
RSSH/PP HRH-Other 7 Percentage of cases where the malaria RDT was performed to standard by the CHW during the reporting period
RSSH/PP HRH-5 - Other 5 Percentage of Community Health Centers (CSCom) receiving formative supervision (at least once every six months)
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
RSSH/PP HRH-Other 2 Average number of home visits (curative consultations) per community health worker (CHW) per month
RSSH/PP HRH-Other 1 Proportion of community health workers who received at least one formative supervision during the reporting period
RSSH/PP HRH-5 - Other 4 Percentage of Reference Health Centers (CSRef) having benefited from formative supervision (at least once every six months)
RSSH/PP HRH-Other 3 Number of curative consultations (new cases) performed by functional CHWs on children aged 0-5 during the reporting period
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes

Malaria I - Other 2 Malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Malaria I - Other 1 Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
TB I - Other 1 Tuberculosis incidence rate per 100,000 population
HIV I - Other 2 Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
HIV I - Other 1 Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
HIV I - Other 3 Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIVdelivering in the last 12 months
TB I - Other 2 Tuberculosis mortality rate per 100,000 population
